text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото finishes the race with good
results.
By my analysis, not only is she
performing well,
she's showing she can
hold her own in her
senior-year graded
races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But Матиканэфукукитару thwarts our
eager
procession toward the spring G1.
Our next goal,
and preliminary for the
G1, becomes the Kinko
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
